# Direction: [0, 0, 1] - removing periodicity in z-direction

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
dimension 3

# Read structure
read_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_2/brief/aluminum_surface_2_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_4/structure.data

# Replicate 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Remove periodic boundary condition in z-direction to create slab
change_box all boundary p p s

# Energy minimization settings
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step pe ke etotal temp press vol

# Perform energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 10000 100000

# Output final energy
variable final_energy equal pe
print "Final potential energy: ${final_energy} eV"

# Write relaxed structure
write_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_2/brief/aluminum_surface_2_subtask_slab_energy_minimisation_trial_4/relaxed_slab.data

print "Relaxation complete"
